biggest_catch: This offer is Colorado-only — your primary physical address must be in Colorado — and the $450 needs $3,000 in aggregate qualifying direct deposits within 90 days; plus a $750 tier exists on Premier Checking.
catches: Colorado residents only: your primary physical address on the account must be in Colorado. BOK Financial operates in eight states, but this specific offer is Colorado-only.
The promo code SUMMIT is required to participate — accounts opened without an eligible promo code do not qualify.

To qualify for the $450 bonus: open an Access Checking account with promo code SUMMIT and receive at least $3,000 in aggregate qualifying direct deposits within the first 90 days of account opening. (A $750 tier exists on Premier Checking with the same promo code; a $300 offer is student-only.)

Qualifying direct deposits are recurring electronic payroll, pension, Social Security, or regular income from an employer, payroll provider, or government agency — transfers between accounts, P2P transfers (including Zelle), bank-to-bank transfers, wire transfers, and branch/ATM/mobile deposits do not qualify.
Ninety days after account opening the account is evaluated, and if all qualifications are met the bonus is credited within the following 30 days — roughly a 3–4 month wait.
The qualifying account must be open and in good standing at payout; new accounts are subject to approval.
The bonus is considered interest and reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
This offer expires December 31, 2026 (BOK Financial may change or discontinue it at any time); limit one bonus per customer; not available to BOK Financial employees.
New customer means not listed as a primary or secondary accountholder on any existing checking account and no checking account closed in the past 180 days.

steps: Go to the official BOK Financial Colorado offer page https://www.bokfinancial.com/landing-pages/offers/colorado-checking-saving-bonus and confirm the offer is still active (it expires December 31, 2026).
Open a new Access Checking account using promo code SUMMIT before December 31, 2026 — your primary physical address must be in Colorado, and accounts opened without the promo code do not qualify.
Note your account opening date — your 90-day qualification window starts then.

Within the first 90 days, receive at least $3,000 in aggregate qualifying direct deposits — recurring payroll, pension, Social Security, or regular income from an employer, payroll provider, or government agency; Zelle, bank-to-bank transfers, and wires do not count.
Keep the account open and in good standing; 90 days after opening the account is evaluated and the $450 bonus is credited within the following 30 days.
